## What changes for the user

## Scope
- [ ] Viewer/documentation only; geometry hashes unchanged
- [ ] Model geometry change; evidence and reviewed record in `changes/`

## Geometry review (only when applicable)
- Affected part IDs:
- Measured before/after values and units:
- Datum/reference, method, uncertainty and source:
- Why the original-design arrangement remains valid:
- Unrelated parts confirmed unchanged:
- Reviewer and change record:

## Validation
- [ ] `npm run build` passed
- [ ] Desktop orbit / zoom / pan / select / focus / isolate / restore checked
- [ ] Exterior, open interior and cutaway checked from top and both sides
- [ ] Keel endpoints and galley movement checked
- [ ] GLB and offline viewer checked
- [ ] Phone/touch check completed or its limitation recorded
- [ ] Accuracy notes and changelog updated where needed
